name: DeepTutor v1 Personal AI Tutor
description: Personalized AI tutoring over your own documents, with quizzes and notes.

PORT.description: Port of the Next.js web app (0.0.0.0). Railway routes the public domain and the /api/auth/status healthcheck here; the app proxies /api and /ws to the API on 127.0.0.1:8001.

DEEPTUTOR_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Username of the admin account (3-64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', or an email).

DEEPTUTOR_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password, generated at deploy (min. 12 characters). Login is always required; the public sign-up page stays closed. To rotate, change it here and redeploy.

DEEPTUTOR_TOKEN_EXPIRE_HOURS.description: How long a login stays valid, in hours (upstream default 24).

DEEPTUTOR_CORS_ORIGINS.description: Allowed browser origins for the API, comma-separated. Add your custom domain here if you attach one.

DEEPTUTOR_WORKERS.description: API worker processes (1-8). More than 1 needs Redis; the start script falls back to 1 if Redis is unreachable. Each worker adds roughly 0.4-0.6 GB RAM.

DEEPTUTOR_REDIS_URL.description: Private Redis URL for DeepTutor's turn coordination (event streams, leases, multi-worker mode).

DEEPTUTOR_REDIS_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long the start script waits for Redis before starting with 1 in-memory worker instead.

DEEPTUTOR_ALLOW_CODE_EXEC.description: Keep false unless you need it. true lets admins' chats run model-written code (office-file skills, code answers) as a restricted subprocess inside this container, which can read the app's data and keys. Railway has no Docker sandbox.

LLM_BINDING.description: DeepTutor provider id for LLM_API_KEY, e.g. openai, anthropic, gemini, deepseek, openrouter, groq, mistral.

LLM_API_KEY.description: Optional, recommended. Chat model API key. When set, a 'Railway' provider profile is created and selected on boot. You can instead add providers in Settings after login.

LLM_MODEL.description: Model id on that provider (e.g. gpt-5-mini, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini-2.5-flash).

LLM_BASE_URL.description: Optional. API base URL; empty uses the provider's default (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1).

EMBEDDING_BINDING.description: Embedding provider id for knowledge bases (openai, gemini, cohere, jina, siliconflow, ...).

EMBEDDING_API_KEY.description: Optional. Embedding API key. Empty: reuses LLM_API_KEY (and LLM_BASE_URL) when EMBEDDING_BINDING equals LLM_BINDING. Knowledge bases need an embedding model.

EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Embedding model id used for new knowledge bases.

EMBEDDING_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Embedding endpoint; empty uses LLM_BASE_URL when the LLM key is reused, otherwise the provider's default.

EMBEDDING_DIMENSION.description: Optional. Vector size. Empty: 1536/3072 for OpenAI text-embedding-3-small/-large, otherwise the provider's default.

BACKEND_HOST.description: Bind address of the FastAPI backend. Loopback only: the browser reaches it through the web app's proxy, never directly.

TZ.description: Time zone for the backend and frontend (e.g. Europe/Istanbul).

DEEPTUTOR_EXTRAS.description: Optional upstream extras installed on every start, comma-separated (e.g. parse-markitdown, rag-lightrag). Slows boot; the pip cache is kept on the volume.

DEEPTUTOR_APT_PACKAGES.description: Optional Debian packages installed on every start, comma-separated (e.g. ffmpeg).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period on redeploy so running answers are saved (the backend gets 30 s before it is stopped).

REDISHOST.description: Private network hostname of the Redis service, only resolvable from services in the same environment

REDIS_URL.description: Connection string for connecting to Redis using the private network

REDISPASSWORD.description: Alias of REDIS_PASSWORD for clients that expect the unseparated name

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Randomly generated password for authenticating with Redis
